# Code of Conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant v2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/). Contributors are expected to participate respectfully and to follow its standards in project spaces and when representing the project.

Report conduct concerns privately to [conduct@reponomics.org](mailto:conduct@reponomics.org). Include the relevant context and links where available. This contact is for conduct reports; suspected software vulnerabilities belong in the [private security reporting channel](SECURITY.md).
